name: Etta Lorne

Important Figures Etta Lorne (LN) — Town Sheriff

Etta is a former caravan guard and longtime resident of Blackvein who was elected sheriff shortly before the establishment of the marquisate. A capable lawkeeper with an unremarkable manner, she earned the confidence of the town's inhabitants through her willingness to confront violent prospectors, dishonest merchants, and dangerous outlaws without regard for their wealth or reputation.

Etta is no romantic defender of frontier lawlessness. She recognizes that Blackvein's old customs were frequently arbitrary and that a more reliable legal system would benefit the settlement. Nevertheless, she resents the marquis's assumption that his authority automatically supersedes the agreements under which the town was founded.

She maintains a respectful but sometimes strained relationship with Sir Halden Crowmark, captain of the Iron Spurs. The two share a dislike of banditry and corruption, and Etta acknowledges that the Rangers provide essential protection to isolated mining communities. However, she considers their interference in local criminal investigations an affront to the sheriff's office and has occasionally refused to surrender prisoners without a properly issued warrant.
